title: Pin the causal admission connection immediately before its first possible write
outcome: An unsent causal admission can use the legitimate current destination after an ordinary settings or actor change; once a write may have reached the consumer, retries keep the original connection and exact bytes.
acceptance: Behavioral evidence covers a capability/read failure before any write followed by a destination settings change, and an unknown write followed by a change; only the unsent case may acquire the new connection.
